xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4734: Fly work agents run as linked conversations on the VM's server (closes PAN-1775)

plan.title: Fly work agents run as linked conversations on the VM's server (closes PAN-1775)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The finalize lint counts every docs/*.md and configuration/*.mdx path as its own subsystem, so any change spanning src/lib, src/dashboard, src/cli and four doc files exceeds 6 regardless of coupling. The ~40 files are one vertical change: the work door (service, route, CLI) is useless without the reap, tmux-target and loop changes that keep tell/kill/output/reap working against the new session, and the issue-tree row is what closes PAN-1775, which this issue's title promises. Splitting the row out would leave this issue unable to close PAN-1775; splitting the loops out would ship a VM that the sweep destroys or the cap double-counts.

narratives.Problem: pan start --remote work agents run Claude Code in raw tmux over the Fly Machines exec API with no Overdeck server, so home sees no transcript and no issue-tree row until the reap (PAN-1775). PAN-4652 made a Fly VM a linked machine whose conversations stream live at home, but nothing starts a work agent there; an owner-spawned agent-<issue> would be excluded from the shared list and destroyed by the idle sweep.
narratives.Proposal: pan start --remote (and --machine fly) POSTs a new dashboard route, POST /api/remote/work-agents. Its service provisions a Fly machine with addFlyMachine, creates the issue worktree on the VM with git worktree add, and starts the work prompt as a conversation through the link (POST /api/conversations with cwd and issueId). remote-state records the linked fields, including the VM tmux session conv-<name> and socket, and the remote tmux helpers resolve their target from it so tell, kill, output and the reap keep working. The loops skip linked states (the Fly record owns cap, heartbeat, credentials), the sweep leaves a working agent's VM to the reap, and the reap tears down through the Fly machine path. Resource discovery lists cached linked conversations under their issue so the tree row opens /conv/@<env>/<name>.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Durable tier for Fly work agents: pan start --remote refuses it and never falls back to a legacy VM.
- Codex or any harness other than Claude Code as a Fly work agent.
- pan start --machine auto creating a Fly VM under remote.auto_fly (not on main; follow-up after PAN-4743).
- pan worker run --machine fly and pan lane start --machine fly (PAN-4743, PAN-4811).
- Deleting legacy raw-tmux remote code (createRemoteWorkspace, spawnRemoteAgent, handleRemoteAgentSpawn, /api/remote/workspaces/*, pan workspace create --remote); legacy remote-state keeps working unchanged.
- Pull here for a linked work agent.
- Review, test or merge running on the Fly VM.
- A SessionNode contract change or rendering a linked conversation in SessionPanel.
- Docker Compose stacks for the agent on the VM.
- A dashboard Machine field for issue starts.
- Changing pan tell, pan kill, messaging.ts, routes/agents/conversation.ts or agent-output-service.ts call sites (target resolution lives in the remote helpers).
- Changing the shared conversation list's agent-% filter.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the issue-tree row in this issue and set sizeJustification instead of splitting it out.
autoDecisions.rationale: The row is what closes PAN-1775, which the issue title promises; the size lint's subsystem count is driven by per-file doc paths.

autoDecisions.summary: The tree row is a conversation row fed by home's linked conversation cache, not a new SessionNode.
autoDecisions.rationale: FeatureItem already renders resourceDetails.conversations as /conv links and SharedConversationRow carries issueId; a SessionNode row would need a contracts change and a SessionPanel that cannot render linked conversations.

autoDecisions.summary: Take pan start --machine fly as an alias of --remote; leave remote.auto_fly for pan start to a follow-up.
autoDecisions.rationale: The planning comment names this issue as the owner of --machine fly; remote.auto_fly is PAN-4743's unmerged setting.

autoDecisions.summary: pan start --remote calls a new dashboard route (POST /api/remote/work-agents) instead of provisioning in the CLI.
autoDecisions.rationale: addFlyMachine needs notifyLinksChanged and linkFetch needs the dashboard's link pool; POST /api/machines/fly sets the precedent.

autoDecisions.summary: Start the agent with POST /api/conversations, not the owner's issue-start door.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for it; server-generated YYYYMMDD-NNNN names pass the shared list's agent-% filter; the owner door would run the pipeline on the VM.

autoDecisions.summary: Create the VM worktree with git worktree add (not pan workspace create) and use it as the conversation cwd.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan task resolves <project>/workspaces/feature-<issue>; createWorkspace's 10 GiB disk floor has no bypass and a Fly rootfs is not guaranteed to meet it.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve the tmux session and socket from remote-state inside the remote helpers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps tell.ts, kill.ts, messaging.ts and both output paths unchanged and keeps legacy states byte-identical.

autoDecisions.summary: The sweep skips idle-removal of a Fly machine with a running linked agent; the reap owns its teardown.
autoDecisions.rationale: The sweep is not behind the deacon freeze and could destroy the VM before the hand-off, so review would never be requested.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse the durable tier and non-Anthropic models for Fly work agents.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fly machines are ephemeral-only (PAN-4652) and the REMOTE prompt contract is Claude Code's.

autoDecisions.summary: Include an operator-consented live checkpoint item with explicit fallbacks.
autoDecisions.rationale: The Done-when is observable only on a real Fly machine; PAN-4652 WI-14 set the pattern.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-7. New src/dashboard/server/services/fly-work-agent-service.ts exporting startFlyWorkAgent(input, deps) and FlyWorkAgentError. Steps in order: resolve project (resolveProjectFromIssueSync, else project-unknown 404); model via determineModel(role work) + resolveEffort(harness claude-code), non-anthropic provider => harness-unsupported 400; remote-state status running, or starting with startedAt under 30 minutes old => already-running 409; a starting state 30+ minutes old is crashed provisioning and is overwritten; consent wrap per D-11; save remote-state starting with linked true, vmName '', tmuxSocket 'overdeck'; addFlyMachine({projectKey, harness:'claude-code'},{notifyLinksChanged}); patch vmName=machineName, environmentId, linkId, flyMachineId; ensureFlyWorkspace; copy home .overdeck/continue.json to <workdir>/.overdeck/continue.json when present; fly.copySkillsToVm; build prompt (env REMOTE, workspacePath workdir, skipDynamicContext) inline when <=50,000 chars else write /workspace/.pan/prompts/agent-<issue-lower>.md and send the pointer sentence; startFlyConversation with cwd and issueId; patch conversationName and tmuxSession; installPushDaemon with workdir; accept consent; save running; refresh linked cache via currentLinkedConversationsSync()?.onConnect(link). Rollback after addFlyMachine: injected unlink(linkId) (non-200 logged with [fly-work]), save status error, rethrow. Every dependency injectable.
